Summary\n\nImplements 11 case-changing utility methods on the `Bun` global object, matching the [`change-case`](https://github.com/blakeembrey/change-case) npm package behavior exactly. Resolves #15087.\n\n## Functions\n\n| Function | Example |\n|---|---|\n| `Bun.camelCase(\"two words\")` | `\"twoWords\"` |\n| `Bun.pascalCase(\"two words\")` | `\"TwoWords\"` |\n| `Bun.snakeCase(\"two words\")` | `\"two_words\"` |\n| `Bun.kebabCase(\"two words\")` | `\"two-words\"` |\n| `Bun.constantCase(\"two words\")` | `\"TWO_WORDS\"` |\n| `Bun.dotCase(\"two words\")` | `\"two.words\"` |\n| `Bun.capitalCase(\"two words\")` | `\"Two Words\"` |\n| `Bun.trainCase(\"two words\")` | `\"Two-Words\"` |\n| `Bun.pathCase(\"two words\")` | `\"two/words\"` |\n| `Bun.sentenceCase(\"two words\")` | `\"Two words\"` |\n| `Bun.noCase(\"twoWords\")` | `\"two words\"` |\n\n## Implementation\n\n- **`src/string_case.zig`**: Core algorithm with word boundary iterator and case conversion\n- Uses **ICU** (`icu_toUpper`, `icu_toLower`, `icu_hasBinaryProperty`) for full Unicode case conversion and alphabetic detection\n- Uses **`bun.strings.UnsignedCodepointIterator`** for codepoint iteration and **`bun.strings.encodeWTF8RuneT`** for encoding\n- Word splitting implements `change-case`'s three-phase algorithm:\n  1. Lower/digit → upper boundary (`\"camelCase\"` → `\"camel\"` + `\"Case\"`)\n  2. Upper + upper + lower boundary (`\"XMLParser\"` → `\"XML\"` + `\"Parser\"`)\n  3. Non-letter/non-digit separators\n\n## Files Changed\n\n| File | Change |\n|------|--------|\n| `src/string_case.zig` | New: core algorithm |\n| `src/bun.zig` | Import string_case module |\n| `src/bun.js/api/BunObject.zig` | 11 callback wrappers |\n| `src/bun.js/bindings/BunObject+exports.h` | 11 callback declarations |\n| `src/bun.js/bindings/BunObject.cpp` | 11 table entries |\n| `src/bun.js/bindings/workaround-missing-symbols.cpp` | ICU wrappers (`icu_toUpper`, `icu_toLower`) |\n| `packages/bun-types/bun.d.ts` | TypeScript declarations |\n| `test/js/bun/util/case-change.test.ts` | 2098 tests (all pass) |\n\n## Testing\n\n- **2098 tests** comparing output against the `change-case` npm package\n- Covers: all 11 case types, Unicode (café, naïve, résumé), acronyms (XML, HTTP, JSON), digits, edge cases, idempotency, cross-conversion round-trips, error handling\n- `bun bd test test/js/bun/util/case-change.test.ts` → 2098 pass, 0 fail\n- `USE_SYSTEM_BUN=1 bun test test/js/bun/util/case-change.test.ts` → 2021 fail (confirms new functionality)","reactions":{"url":"https://api.github.com/repos/oven-sh/bun/issues/26772/reactions","total_count":3,"+1":3,"-1":0,"laugh":0,"hooray":0,"confused":0,"heart":0,"rocket":0,"eyes":0},"timeline_url":"https://api.github.com/repos/oven-sh/bun/issues/26772/timeline","performed_via_github_app":null,"state_reason":null,"score":1.0}],"search_type":"lexical"}
